title: Use the orders board
summary: See orders in columns by stage, move them by dragging and limit final columns to recent days.

steps.title: Menu → Clinic History → Lab Orders
steps.details: The jobs sent to external labs and the stage each one is in.

steps.title: Drag the card
steps.details: Drop it in another column to change its stage: it is saved right away and goes back if saving fails. On a phone, use “Move to…” in the card menu.

steps.title: Final columns
steps.details: Final stages only show what arrived in the last 7, 30 or 90 days, so they do not grow forever.
